units.source_text: 正在此时，太政大臣亡故了。

en.t: Just then, the Minister of the Great Council passed away.

units.source_text: 照年龄而论，此人之死原不足怪。

en.t: Considering his age, there was nothing especially surprising about his death.

units.source_text: 然而除了此人之外，死亡疾病等事接踵而起，四境人口不宁。

en.t: Yet beyond his death, sickness and other calamities followed one after another, and people throughout the realm were uneasy.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿太后想不到也生起病来，身体日益衰弱。

en.t: Unexpectedly, the Empress Mother of Kokiden also fell ill, and her body grew weaker day by day.
Emperor Suzaku was overwhelmed with grief.

units.source_text: 他想：“源氏公子蒙无实之罪，受沉沦之苦。

en.t: He thought, "Prince Genji has borne a false accusation and suffered the misery of disgrace.

units.source_text: 此天灾定是政令不公的报应了。”

en.t: These disasters must surely be retribution for unjust government."

units.source_text: 便屡次向母后启请：“如今可以赐还源氏的官爵了。”

en.t: So he repeatedly petitioned his mother, saying, "Now we may restore Genji's offices and rank."

units.source_text: 太后答道：“现在就恢复官爵，世间必说此举轻率。

en.t: The Empress Mother replied, "If his offices and rank are restored now, people will surely call the action rash.

units.source_text: 凡获罪去京的人，不满三年即便赦罪，必遭世人非议。”

en.t: When someone has been punished and sent away from the capital, pardoning him before three full years have passed will certainly draw public criticism."
She firmly remonstrated against it and held him back.

units.source_text: 但在这多方顾虑的期间，她的病势日渐深重了。

en.t: But while these many concerns weighed on her, her illness grew steadily more severe.
